explication: HugoBlox is a Markdown-first framework for creating professional static sites. Its documented workflow is to start from a template, generate or edit structured pages, and deploy the resulting static site. The sampled implementation shows browser-side Preact hydration for the Blox components, but not the templates’ rendering pipeline or the broader content-type implementations; those documented capabilities are represented at the directory level where possible. Edges between sampled clients and components are evidenced by their imports and render calls.
